decisive_items: Some P waves do not conduct to ventricles
prolonged His-ventricular (HV) interval of 75 milliseconds on first conducted beat, extending to 277 milliseconds on second conducted beat
PR interval prolongs between first and second conducted beats
response.rationale: Intermittent non-conducted P waves with infranodal His-ventricular prolongation and right bundle-branch block localize the block to the His-Purkinje system, making Mobitz Type II second-degree AV block the most specific supported diagnosis; the broader AV block label is less specific.

rejected.why: Duplicate Mobitz II diagnosis with less complete candidate support.
Right bundle-branch block is a coexisting ECG finding, not the cause of intermittent AV block.
Sick sinus syndrome is not supported because the rhythm is sinus with AV block, not sinus node dysfunction.
Bundle branch block alone does not explain non-conducted P waves or prolonged HV interval.
